capacity.convertLowRam: This device can convert Word files up to about {maxMb}. Larger or complex files may fail in the browser — try a smaller file or the future desktop app.
capacity.convertInfo: Browser conversion is capacity-gated (about {maxMb} on this device). Complex Word layouts may not be preserved exactly.
capacity.compressLowRam: On this device, prefer Balanced compression and smaller PDFs. Maximum mode can run out of memory on phones.
capacity.compressInfo: Balanced keeps selectable text. Maximum re-encodes pages as images and needs more memory — prefer it on desktop for large files.
